June, in #strategic-pod Gideon said he closed ticket **#8841** with support on 1 Jul. The fix was that Vantorre's IT cleared a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets, after which the standard Detention Summary template worked for their billing team.

I can't confirm the ticket's own record. Other notes in the brain describe #8841 differently, as a Newark check-in kiosk problem with Dock Door 14 and as an Allentown gate kiosk timeout at Door 12. Gideon can confirm which one it was.
